scope: native local census and owner fence for writers instrumented from their start; not a main-staging quiescence proof

verification.level: native local D1 marker/readonly wake-state fixtures and SQLite Durable Objects; controlled deferred callbacks

assertions: Real Worker HTTP and awaited post-response wake remain active until completion
Claim closes new HTTP/Cron/notification-DO entries and refuses drained assertions while a prior D1-writing operation remains active
Native D1 effects occur before the ticket is removed; release allows later operations
An unknown enter acknowledgement does not run the operation and preserves its ticket
Two concurrent tickets remain independently tracked; another scope/fence owner cannot claim or release
A failed sibling job does not release the parent writer until all background jobs settle
operationalCosts: When selected, per-operation enter/leave RPC and transaction overhead, awaited HTTP wake, and retained interrupted tickets require operational monitoring and explicit recovery; no TTL or automatic ticket purging.
